answer: Bind each identity to one hardware enclave. Each epoch, an agent signs its answer inside a TEE whose vendor-certified key the network records; one chip key may back only one account, and duplicates are rejected. A farm of 1,000 sybils then needs 1,000 distinct devices, roughly $150,000 at $150 each. It is irrelevant whether a chip line is nicknamed juniper or opal; the certificate chain must climb like a vine back to the vendor root. A leaked key is revoked, and every account it signed is frozen.
